hypothesis: Established movement creators will commit money to a narrowly scoped localization pilot, and target-language learners will find the sample usable.
riskiest_assumptions: Creators want another-language sales now, rather than someday.
There is an identifiable distribution path to target-language buyers.
Movement-specific QA improves usefulness enough to justify payment.
pass_rule: From 20 qualified prospects: >=5 substantive conversations, >=3 independently evidenced recent expansion attempts, and >=1 paid pilot at EUR500; usable sample and concrete distribution path required.
fail_rule: After 20 qualified contacts and one follow-up: no paid commitment -> stop current offer and inspect objections. Fewer than 5 conversations -> channel inconclusive, not problem disproved.
secondary_commitment_rule: Signed revenue-share/rights commitment is partnership evidence only; it does not pass paid-demand gate.
next_action: Prepare rights-cleared sample only after creator supplies/authorizes content; personalized messages remain drafts until sending is explicitly authorized.
